title: /integrations/local_ip
description: Instructions on how to integrate the Local IP Address sensor into Home Assistant.
body: The **Local IP Address**  will expose the local (LAN) IP address of your Home Assistant instance. This can be useful when your instance has a static public hostname (for example, if you use the Nabu Casa service), but have a dynamically allocated local LAN address (for example, configured via DHCP).
